description: This file defines the code-behind logic for the 'SetExam' web page in an online examination system. It includes event handlers for UI controls to select courses based on semester, add questions to a database, set up exams, and navigate between pages.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.SetExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the 'SetExam' ASP.NET Web Forms page, managing course selection, question addition, and exam setup functionalities.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; currently has commented-out code for session management.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields related to question data.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a multiple-choice question into the database, updates question number, and notifies the user.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Adds exam details to the database and redirects to the admin panel.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course list based on semester selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Sets the question number based on the selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.
